spec.title: 02 - AI gateway
spec.description: LiteLLM, the gateway in front of the local and SaaS models: traffic, failures, latency, spend and deployments.

spec.title: Health
spec.description: FAILED: a deployment is out or LiteLLM is down. DEGRADED: a partial outage, or more than 5 % of the requests fail.

spec.expr: max(label_replace(vector(0), "k", "0", "", "") or label_replace(max(litellm_deployment_state), "k", "1", "", "") or label_replace(2 * (max(up{job="litellm"}) == bool 0), "k", "2", "", "") or label_replace(((sum(rate(litellm_proxy_failed_requests_metric_total[5m])) / (sum(rate(litellm_proxy_total_requests_metric_total[5m])))) >= bool 0.05) + ((sum(rate(litellm_proxy_failed_requests_metric_total[5m])) / (sum(rate(litellm_proxy_total_requests_metric_total[5m])))) >= bool 0.25), "k", "3", "", ""))

spec.title: Traffic
spec.description: Requests per minute, keys and models in use (24 h).

spec.title: Errors
spec.description: Failed requests (24 h) and the failure share (5 min).

spec.title: Latency
spec.description: Average request time, time to the first token and the gateway's own overhead (5 min).

spec.title: Spend
spec.description: What the gateway billed (24 h): local models cost 0.

spec.title: Deployments
spec.description: Model deployments behind the gateway by state.

spec.title: Health history
spec.description: Global health and health of every tab (0 OK, 1 DEGRADED, 2 FAILED).

spec.expr: max(label_replace(vector(0), "k", "0", "", "") or label_replace(max(litellm_deployment_state), "k", "1", "", "") or label_replace(2 * (max(up{job="litellm"}) == bool 0), "k", "2", "", "") or label_replace(((sum(rate(litellm_proxy_failed_requests_metric_total[5m])) / (sum(rate(litellm_proxy_total_requests_metric_total[5m])))) >= bool 0.05) + ((sum(rate(litellm_proxy_failed_requests_metric_total[5m])) / (sum(rate(litellm_proxy_total_requests_metric_total[5m])))) >= bool 0.25), "k", "3", "", ""))
